    name: "form-info",
    summary: "<p>这是一个基于 React 和 Ant Design 的高颜值表单组件库，专为现代化 Web 应用设计。该组件库通过优雅的视觉设计和丰富的交互功能，为开发者提供了一套完整的表单解决方案。</p>\n<h4>核心特点</h4>\n<p><strong>美观优雅的界面设计</strong> - 采用现代化的视觉风格，配合精心设计的间距、色彩和排版，让表单界面更加专业美观。</p>\n<p><strong>多样化的表单组件</strong> - 提供 FormInfo、FormModal、FormSteps、FormStepsModal、List、TableList、MultiField 等丰富的表单组件，满足各种复杂的业务场景需求。</p>\n<p><strong>灵活的布局系统</strong> - 支持响应式网格布局和 Flexbox 布局，可以轻松实现单列、多列以及自定义复杂布局。</p>\n<p><strong>强大的列表功能</strong> - 内置 List、TableList 等列表组件，支持动态添加/删除、嵌套列表等高级功能。</p>\n<p><strong>多步骤表单支持</strong> - 提供 FormSteps 和 FormStepsModal 组件，轻松实现向导式表单流程，提升用户体验。</p>\n<p><strong>国际化支持</strong> - 内置中英文语言包，支持自定义国际化文本，便于多语言应用开发。</p>\n<p><strong>完整的事件系统</strong> - 提供丰富的回调函数和事件钩子，支持表单验证、数据处理、状态管理等完整生命周期控制。</p>\n<p><strong>高度可定制</strong> - 组件设计充分考虑扩展性，支持自定义样式、图标、按钮文本等，满足个性化需求。</p>\n<p>该组件库特别适合企业级应用、管理系统、数据录入平台等需要大量表单交互的场景，能够显著提升开发效率和用户体验。</p>",

<code>DeleteOutlined</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>empty</td>\n<td>空状态</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td><code>Empty</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>itemTitle</td>\n<td>子项标题函数</td>\n<td><code>function</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>className</td>\n<td>样式类名</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>MultiField</h4>\n<p>同一字段可动态增减多条（同类型控件）。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性名</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td>字段名</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td>字段标签</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>field</td>\n<td>字段组件</td>\n<td><code>ComponentType</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>block</td>\n<td>是否块级</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>rule</td>\n<td>校验规则字符串</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>addText</td>\n<td>添加文案；可为 <code>(label) =&gt; string</code></td>\n<td><code>string | function</code></td>\n<td>添加</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>removeText</td>\n<td>删除文案；可为函数；传 <code>null</code> 隐藏</td>\n<td><code>string | function | null</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>addIcon / removeIcon</td>\n<td>图标</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td><code>PlusOutlined</code> / <code>DeleteOutlined</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>empty</td>\n<td>空状态</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td><code>Empty</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>className</td>\n<td>样式类名</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>国际化</h4>\n<p>内置文案键（<code>zh-CN</code> / <code>en-US</code>）：</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>键名</th>\n<th>中文</th>\n<th>英文</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>submit</td>\n<td>提交</td>\n<td>Submit</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>cancel</td>\n<td>取消</td>\n<td>Cancel</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>complete</td>\n<td>完成</td>\n<td>Complete</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>prev</td>\n<td>上一步</td>\n<td>Previous</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>next</td>\n<td>下一步</td>\n<td>Next</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>addText</td>\n<td>添加</td>\n<td>Add</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>deleteText</td>\n<td>删除</td>\n<td>Delete</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>untitledStep</td>\n<td>第{index}步</td>\n<td>Step {index}</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>可通过 <code>withLocale</code> 或 <code>@kne/react-intl</code> 的 <code>useIntl</code> 覆盖。</p>\n<p>&lt;!--START_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>组件</th>\n<th>简介</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><a href=\"docs/FormInfo.md\">FormInfo</a></td>\n<td>这是一个基于 React 和 Ant Design 的高颜值表单组件库，专为现代化 Web 应用设计。该组件库通过优雅的视觉设计和丰富的交互功能，为开发者提供了一套完整的表单解决方案。 ## 核心特点 <strong>美观优雅的界面设计</strong> -…</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>&lt;!--END_SECTION:DOC_MD--&gt;</p>",
    example: {
        isFull: true,
        className: "form_info_8aabc",
        style: ".kne-responsive-boundary {\n  position: relative;\n}\n\n.kne-responsive-scroll {\n  overflow: auto;\n}\n\n:root {\n  --kne-viewport-width: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-height: 100dvh;\n  --kne-viewport-inline-size: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-block-size: 100dvh;\n}\n\n.kne-responsive-boundary {\n  --kne-viewport-width: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-height: 100dvh;\n  --kne-viewport-inline-size: 100vw;\n  --kne-viewport-block-size: 100dvh;\n}\n\n@container kne-responsive (max-width: 768px) {\n  .form_info_8aabc .example-driver-runner {\n    padding: 12px 16px 24px;\n    box-sizing: border-box;\n  }\n}",
        list: [{
    title: "基础表单示例",
    description: "展示FormInfo、List、TableList、MultiField等基础组件的组合使用，包含普通字段、隐藏字段、多字段、列表、表格列表等多种表单元素的完整示例",
    code: "const {default: FormInfo, List, TableList, MultiField, Form, Input, TextArea, SubmitButton, ResetButton} = _FormInfo;\nconst {Flex, message, Divider, Switch, Space} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n    const [formData, setFormData] = useState({\n        employeeId: 'EMP20240001',\n        name: '张三',\n        department: '技术研发部',\n        position: '高级前端工程师'\n    });\n\n    // 模拟表单提交\n    const handleSubmit = async (formData) => {\n        setLoading(true);\n        console.log('提交的表单数据:', formData);\n        \n        // 模拟API请求\n        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));\n        \n        message.success('员工信息提交成功！');\n        setLoading(false);\n    };\n\n    return <Form data={formData} onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n        <FormInfo \n            title=\"员工基本信息\" \n            subtitle=\"请填写员工的基本个人信息\" \n            column={2}\n            gap={20}\n            list={[\n                <Input name=\"employeeId\" label=\"工号\" rule=\"REQ\" disabled />,\n                <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入员工姓名\" />,\n                <Input name=\"department\" label=\"所属部门\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：技术研发部\" />,\n                <Input name=\"position\" label=\"职位\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：高级前端工程师\" />,\n                <Input name=\"phone\" label=\"联系电话\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" placeholder=\"请输入11位手机号\" />,\n                <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" placeholder=\"请输入企业邮箱\" />,\n                <Input name=\"idCard\" label=\"身份证号\" rule=\"REQ ID_CARD\" placeholder=\"请输入18位身份证号\" />,\n                <TextArea name=\"skills\" label=\"技能特长\" placeholder=\"请描述员工的专业技能\" block />,\n                <MultiField \n                    name=\"certificates\" \n                    label=\"职业证书\" \n                    field={Input} \n                    block\n                    addText=\"添加证书\"\n                    placeholder=\"例如：PMP项目管理认证\"\n                />,\n                <TextArea name=\"remarks\" label=\"备注信息\" placeholder=\"其他需要说明的信息\" block />\n            ]}\n        />\n        \n        <Divider />\n        \n        <List \n            title=\"工作经历\" \n            name=\"workExperience\"\n            bordered\n            itemTitle={({index, data}) => data?.companyName || `工作经历 ${index + 1}`}\n            important\n            maxLength={5}\n            addText=\"添加工作经历\"\n            list={[\n                <Input name=\"companyName\" label=\"公司名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：阿里巴巴集团\" />,\n                <Input name=\"jobTitle\" label=\"职位名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：高级开发工程师\" />,\n                <Input name=\"workYears\" label=\"工作年限\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：3年\" />,\n                <TextArea name=\"workDescription\" label=\"工作描述\" placeholder=\"请描述主要工作内容和成就\" block />,\n                <List \n                    title=\"项目经历\" \n                    name=\"projects\"\n                    bordered\n                    itemTitle={({index, data}) => data?.projectName || `项目 ${index + 1}`}\n                    list={[\n                        <Input name=\"projectName\" label=\"项目名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：双十一活动系统\" />,\n                        <Input name=\"projectRole\" label=\"担任角色\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：技术负责人\" />,\n                        <TextArea name=\"projectDescription\" label=\"项目描述\" placeholder=\"项目背景、职责和成果\" block />\n                    ]}\n                    block\n                />\n            ]}\n        />\n        \n        <Divider />\n        \n        <TableList \n            title=\"家庭成员信息\" \n            name=\"familyMembers\"\n            itemTitle={({index}) => `家庭成员 ${index + 1}`}\n            maxLength={10}\n            addText=\"添加家庭成员\"\n            list={[\n                <Input name=\"memberName\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"家庭成员姓名\" />,\n                <Input name=\"relationship\" label=\"关系\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：配偶、子女\" />,\n                <Input name=\"memberPhone\" label=\"联系电话\" rule=\"TEL\" placeholder=\"联系电话\" />,\n                <Input name=\"workUnit\" label=\"工作单位\" placeholder=\"工作单位名称\" />\n            ]}\n        />\n        \n        <Divider />\n        \n        <FormInfo \n            title=\"紧急联系人\" \n            column={3}\n            list={[\n                <Input name=\"emergencyContact\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"紧急联系人姓名\" />,\n                <Input name=\"emergencyRelation\" label=\"关系\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"与员工关系\" />,\n                <Input name=\"emergencyPhone\" label=\"电话\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" placeholder=\"联系电话\" />\n            ]}\n        />\n        \n        <Flex justify=\"center\" gap={12} style={{marginTop: 24}}>\n            <SubmitButton loading={loading}>提交信息</SubmitButton>\n            <ResetButton>重置表单</ResetButton>\n        </Flex>\n    </Form>;\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample/>);\n\n",

    name: "_FormInfo",
    packageName: "@kne/current-lib_form-info",
    component: component_1
},{

    packageName: "antd",
    component: component_2

},{
    title: "混合场景（FormInfo / List / TableList / MultiField / Steps）",
    description: "对齐 form-creator 预览的五种模块同屏组合：验收 TableList 列最小宽度与操作列 sticky、Steps 标题随文字且连线最大 40px、List 默认无边框等",
    code: "const {\n  default: FormInfo,\n  List,\n  TableList,\n  MultiField,\n  Form,\n  Steps,\n  Input,\n  TextArea,\n  Select,\n  SubmitButton,\n  ResetButton\n} = _FormInfo;\nconst {Flex, message} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\n/**\n * 混合场景：FormInfo / List / TableList / MultiField / Steps（嵌入父 Form）\n * 验收：TableList 列宽与 sticky、Steps 样式、下一步校验、提交失败跳步、重置回第一步。\n */\nconst MixedExample = () => {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleSubmit = async data => {\n    setLoading(true);\n    console.log('混合表单提交:', data);\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600));\n    message.success('提交成功');\n    setLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Form\n      data={{\n        name: '张三',\n        mobile: '13800138000',\n        workExperiences: [{company: '示例公司', title: '前端'}],\n        educations: [{school: '示例大学', major: '计算机', degree: 'bachelor'}],\n        backupContacts: ['']\n      }}\n      onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n    >\n      <FormInfo\n        title=\"基本信息\"\n        subtitle=\"请先填写基础资料\"\n        column={2}\n        list={[\n          <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入姓名\" />,\n          <Input name=\"mobile\" label=\"手机号\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" placeholder=\"请输入手机号\" />,\n          <Select\n            name=\"gender\"\n            label=\"性别\"\n            rule=\"REQ\"\n            placeholder=\"请选择\"\n            options={[\n              {label: '男', value: 'male'},\n              {label: '女', value: 'female'}\n            ]}\n          />,\n          <TextArea name=\"remark\" label=\"备注\" block placeholder=\"补充说明\" />\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <List\n        title=\"工作经历\"\n        name=\"workExperiences\"\n        addText=\"添加工作经历\"\n        minLength={1}\n        itemTitle={({index, data}) => data?.company || `工作经历 ${index + 1}`}\n        list={[\n          <Input name=\"company\" label=\"公司\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入公司名称\" />,\n          <Input name=\"title\" label=\"职位\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入职位\" />,\n          <Input name=\"startDate\" label=\"入职时间\" placeholder=\"例如：2020-01\" />\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <TableList\n        title=\"教育经历\"\n        name=\"educations\"\n        addText=\"添加教育经历\"\n        bordered\n        list={[\n          <Input name=\"school\" label=\"学校\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入学校\" />,\n          <Input name=\"major\" label=\"专业\" placeholder=\"请输入专业\" />,\n          <Select\n            name=\"degree\"\n            label=\"学历\"\n            placeholder=\"请选择\"\n            options={[\n              {label: '本科', value: 'bachelor'},\n              {label: '硕士', value: 'master'},\n              {label: '博士', value: 'doctor'}\n            ]}\n          />\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <FormInfo\n        title=\"备用联系方式\"\n        column={1}\n        list={[\n          <MultiField\n            name=\"backupContacts\"\n            label=\"联系方式\"\n            field={Input}\n            block\n            minLength={1}\n            maxLength={3}\n            placeholder=\"请输入联系方式\"\n          />\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <Steps\n        title=\"入职补充信息\"\n        bordered\n        items={[\n          {\n            title: '账号信息',\n            column: 2,\n            list: [\n              <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" placeholder=\"请输入邮箱\" />,\n              <Input name=\"employeeNo\" label=\"工号\" placeholder=\"选填\" />\n            ]\n          },\n          {\n            title: '紧急联系人',\n            column: 2,\n            list: [\n              <Input name=\"emergencyName\" label=\"联系人\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入姓名\" />,\n              <Input name=\"emergencyMobile\" label=\"联系电话\" rule=\"REQ TEL\" placeholder=\"请输入手机号\" />,\n              <Select\n                name=\"emergencyRelation\"\n                label=\"关系\"\n                placeholder=\"请选择\"\n                options={[\n                  {label: '父母', value: 'parent'},\n                  {label: '配偶', value: 'spouse'},\n                  {label: '子女', value: 'child'},\n                  {label: '其他', value: 'other'}\n                ]}\n              />\n            ]\n          },\n          {\n            title: '其他说明',\n            column: 1,\n            list: [\n              <TextArea name=\"onboardNote\" label=\"补充说明\" block placeholder=\"如有特殊需求请填写\" />\n            ]\n          }\n        ]}\n      />\n\n      <Flex justify=\"center\" gap={12} style={{marginTop: 24}}>\n        <SubmitButton loading={loading}>提交</SubmitButton>\n        <ResetButton>重置</ResetButton>\n      </Flex>\n    </Form>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<MixedExample />);\n\n",
    scope: [{
    name: "_FormInfo",
    packageName: "@kne/current-lib_form-info",
    component: component_1
},{
    name: "antd",
    packageName: "antd",
    component: component_2
}]

    title: "超多层列表嵌套",
    description: "第 1～4 级常规嵌套；第 5 级起同宽无缩进，仅第 5 级保留左侧色条；标签可展开/收起；子项 hover 高亮；可切换边框",
    code: "const { default: FormInfo, List, Form, Input, TextArea, SubmitButton, ResetButton } = _FormInfo;\nconst { Flex, message, Alert, Space, Switch } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\n/**\n * 第 1～4 级：常规嵌套样式\n * 第 5 级起（子步骤…）：nest-beyond 满宽同宽；仅第 5 级保留左侧色条\n */\nconst NestedDeepExample = () => {\n  const [bordered, setBordered] = useState(true);\n\n  const handleSubmit = data => {\n    console.log('深层嵌套提交:', data);\n    message.success('提交成功');\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Alert\n        type=\"info\"\n        showIcon\n        message=\"超多层列表嵌套\"\n        description=\"第 1～4 级（部门→小组→成员→任务）为常规嵌套；从第 5 级「子步骤」起同宽无缩进，仅第 5 级保留左侧色条。第 5 级起标签可展开/收起（样式隐藏、不删 DOM），子项 hover 高亮当前范围。\"\n      />\n      <Space>\n        <span>边框模式：</span>\n        <Switch checked={bordered} onChange={setBordered} />\n      </Space>\n      <Form\n        key={bordered ? 'bordered' : 'plain'}\n        data={{\n          departments: [\n            {\n              name: '研发中心',\n              teams: [\n                {\n                  name: '前端组',\n                  members: [\n                    {\n                      name: '张三',\n                      role: '工程师',\n                      email: 'zhangsan@example.com',\n                      city: '上海',\n                      tasks: [\n                        {\n                          title: '表单搭建',\n                          note: '嵌套列表样式',\n                          steps: [\n                            {\n                              name: '样式验收',\n                              checks: [\n                                {\n                                  label: '满宽色条',\n                                  remarks: [{ content: '第 5 层起不再靠缩进表示包含' }]\n                                }\n                              ]\n                            }\n                          ]\n                        }\n                      ]\n                    }\n                  ]\n                }\n              ]\n            }\n          ]\n        }}\n        onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n      >\n        <List\n          title=\"组织架构（第 1 级）\"\n          name=\"departments\"\n          addText=\"添加部门\"\n          bordered={bordered}\n          minLength={1}\n          itemTitle={({ data, index }) => data?.name || `部门 ${index + 1}`}\n          list={[\n            <Input name=\"name\" label=\"部门名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：研发中心\" />,\n            <List\n              title=\"下属小组（第 2 级）\"\n              name=\"teams\"\n              addText=\"添加小组\"\n              bordered={bordered}\n              minLength={1}\n              itemTitle={({ data, index }) => data?.name || `小组 ${index + 1}`}\n              list={[\n                <Input name=\"name\" label=\"小组名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：前端组\" />,\n                <List\n                  title=\"小组成员（第 3 级）\"\n                  name=\"members\"\n                  addText=\"添加成员\"\n                  bordered={bordered}\n                  minLength={1}\n                  itemTitle={({ data, index }) => data?.name || `成员 ${index + 1}`}\n                  list={[\n                    <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"姓名\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"role\" label=\"角色\" placeholder=\"例如：工程师\" />,\n                    <FormInfo\n                      title=\"联系资料\"\n                      column={2}\n                      bordered={bordered}\n                      list={[\n                        <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" placeholder=\"name@example.com\" />,\n                        <Input name=\"city\" label=\"城市\" placeholder=\"所在城市\" />\n                      ]}\n                    />,\n                    <List\n                      title=\"任务明细（第 4 级）\"\n                      name=\"tasks\"\n                      addText=\"添加任务\"\n                      bordered={bordered}\n                      list={[\n                        <Input name=\"title\" label=\"任务\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"任务名称\" />,\n                        <TextArea name=\"note\" label=\"备注\" block placeholder=\"补充说明\" />,\n                        <List\n                          title=\"子步骤（第 5 级·满宽色条）\"\n                          name=\"steps\"\n                          addText=\"添加步骤\"\n                          bordered={bordered}\n                          itemTitle={({ data, index }) => data?.name || `步骤 ${index + 1}`}\n                          list={[\n                            <Input name=\"name\" label=\"步骤名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：样式验收\" />,\n                            <List\n                              title=\"检查项（第 6 级）\"\n                              name=\"checks\"\n                              addText=\"添加检查项\"\n                              bordered={bordered}\n                              itemTitle={({ data, index }) => data?.label || `检查 ${index + 1}`}\n                              list={[\n                                <Input name=\"label\" label=\"检查点\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：满宽色条\" />,\n                                <List\n                                  title=\"备注条（第 7 级）\"\n                                  name=\"remarks\"\n                                  addText=\"添加备注\"\n                                  bordered={bordered}\n                                  list={[\n                                    <TextArea name=\"content\" label=\"说明\" block placeholder=\"更深层级仍保持内容区宽度\" />\n                                  ]}\n                                />\n                              ]}\n                            />\n                          ]}\n                        />\n                      ]}\n                    />\n                  ]}\n                />\n              ]}\n            />\n          ]}\n        />\n        <Flex justify=\"center\" gap={16}>\n          <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          <ResetButton>重置</ResetButton>\n        </Flex>\n      </Form>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<NestedDeepExample />);\n\n",
    scope: [{
    name: "_FormInfo",
    packageName: "@kne/current-lib_form-info",
    component: component_1

    packageName: "antd",

    title: "模态框表单示例",
    description: "演示FormModal组件的使用，展示如何在弹窗中展示表单，支持表单数据初始化和提交后的自动关闭功能",
    code: "const {default: FormInfo, FormModal, List, Input, TextArea, SubmitButton} = _FormInfo;\nconst {useState} = React;\nconst {Button, Space, message, Divider, Switch} = antd;\n\nconst BaseExample = () => {\n    const [open, onOpenChange] = useState(false);\n    const [autoClose, setAutoClose] = useState(true);\n    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n\n    // 模拟编辑的员工数据\n    const [employeeData, setEmployeeData] = useState({\n        id: 'EMP20240001',\n        name: '李四',\n        employeeNo: 'EMP001',\n        department: '产品部',\n        position: '产品经理',\n        phone: '13800138000',\n        email: 'lisi@company.com',\n        entryDate: '2024-01-15',\n        workExperience: [\n            {\n                companyName: '腾讯科技',\n => onOpenChange(false), 500);\n        }\n    };\n\n    // 自定义底部按钮\n    const customFooter = (submitProps) => (\n        <Space>\n            <Button onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>取消</Button>\n  </Button>\n            <Button \n                type=\"primary\" \n                loading={submitProps.loading}\n                onClick={() => {\n                    submitProps.onSubmit();\n                }}\n            >\n                保存并关闭\n            </Button>\n        </Space>\n    );\n\n    return <>\n        <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"middle\">\n            <div>\n                <Space>\n                    <span>自动关闭:</span>\n                    <Switch checked={autoClose} onChange={setAutoClose} />\n                </Space>\n            </div>\n            <Button      open={open} \n            onCancel={() => onOpenChange(false)}\n            formProps={{\n                data: employeeData,\n                onSubmit: handleSubmit\n            }}\n            autoClose={autoClose}\n            okText=\"保存\"\n            cancelText=\"取消\"\n            okType=\"primary\"\n            width={800}\n            okButtonProps={{\n                loading: rule=\"REQ TEL\" placeholder=\"11位手机号\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"EMAIL\" placeholder=\"企业邮箱\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"entryDate\" <Divider />\n            \n            <List\n                title=\"工作经历\" \n                name=\"workExperience\"\n                bordered\n                itemTitle={({index, data}) =>        </FormModal>\n    </>;\n};\n\nrender(<BaseExample/>);\n\n",

<CancelButton>取消</CancelButton>\n                                    <SubmitButton>下一步</SubmitButton>\n                                </Flex>\n                            </>\n                        )\n                    }, {\n                        title: '银行账户',\n                        formProps: {\n                            data: onboardingData\n                        },\n     code: "const { default: FormInfo, FormStepsModal, List, Input, TextArea, Select, DatePicker } = _FormInfo;\nconst { Flex, Button, Space, message, Divider, Result } = antd;\nconst { useState } = endDate: '2024-08-31',\n    budget: '500000',\n\n    // 第二步：项目团队\n    teamMembers: [\n      {\n        name: '张三',\n        role: '技术负责人',\n        email: 'zhangsan@company.com',\n        phone: '13800138000'\n      }\n    ],\n\n    // 第三步：项目详情\n    background: '现有客服系统效率低下，需要引入AI技术提升服务质量',\n    objectives: `1. 响应时间缩短50%\\n2. 客户满意度提升30%\\n3. 人力成本降低40%`,\n    deliverables: '智能客服系统一套，包含前端界面、后台管理、AI对话引擎'\n  };\n\n  // 步骤完成回调\n  const handleComplete = async (formData) => {\n    setLoading(true);\n    console.log('提交的项目申请数据:', formData);\n    \n    // 模拟API提交\n    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));\n    \n    message.success('项目申请提交成功！');\n    setLoading(false);\n    onOpenChange(false);\n    \n    // 可以在这里执行提交后的操作，如跳转到列表页\n  };\n\n  // 步骤变更回调\n  const handleStepChange = (current, data) => {\n    console.log(`切换到第 ${current + 1} 步，当前数据:`, data);\n    setCurrentStep(current);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"middle\">\n      <Button \n        type=\"primary\" \n        size=\"large\"\n        onClick={() => {\n          setCurrentStep(0);\n          onOpenChange(true);\n        }}\n      >\n        新建项目申请\n      </Button>\n\n      <FormStepsModal\n        modalProps={{ \n          open, \n          title: '项目立项申请',\n          onCancel: () => onOpenChange(false),\n          width: 900,\n          destroyOnClose: false\n        }}\n        items={[\n          {\n            title: '基本信息',\n            formProps: {\n              data: projectData\n            },\n            children: (\n              <>\n                <FormInfo \n                  title=\"项目基本信息\" \n                  column={2}\n                  list={[\n                    <Input name=\"projectName\" label=\"项目名称\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"请输入项目名称\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"projectType\" label=\"项目类型\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"例如：内部项目、外部项目\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"department\" label=\"所属部门\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"负责部门\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"priority\" label=\"优先级\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"高、中、低\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"startDate\" label=\"开始日期\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"计划开始时间\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"endDate\" label=\"结束日期\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"计划结束时间\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"budget\" label=\"预算金额\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"项目预算（元）\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"projectManager\" label=\"项目经理\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"项目负责人\" />\n                  ]}\n                />\n                <Divider />\n                <FormInfo \n                  title=\"项目背景\" \n                  column={1}\n                  list={[\n                    <TextArea \n                      name=\"background\" \n                      label=\"项目背景\" \n                      rule=\"REQ\" \n                      placeholder=\"请描述项目背景和必要性\"\n                      block\n                      rows={4}\n                    />\n                  ]}\n                />\n              </>\n            )\n          },\n          {\n            title: '团队配置',\n            formProps: {\n              data: projectData\n            },\n            children: (\n              <>\n                <FormInfo \n                  title=\"核心成员\" \n                  column={2}\n                  list={[\n                    <Input name=\"sponsor\" label=\"项目发起人\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"发起人姓名\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"sponsorDept\" label=\"发起人部门\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"所属部门\" />\n                  ]}\n                />\n                <Divider />\n                <List \n                  title=\"项目团队成员\" \n                  name=\"teamMembers\"\n                  bordered\n                  itemTitle={({index, data}) => data?.name || `成员 ${index + 1}`}\n                  important\n                  maxLength={10}\n                  addText=\"添加团队成员\"\n                  list={[\n                    <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ\" placeholder=\"成员姓名\" />,\n                    <Input name=\"role\" label=\"角色\" list={[\n                    <TextArea \n                      name=\"objectives\" \n                      label=\"项目目标\" \n                      rule=\"REQ\" \n     code: "const {default: FormInfo, List, TableList, Form, Input, TextArea} = _FormInfo;\nconst {Flex, Switch, Space, Divider} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst BorderedExample = () => {\n
